newsitem.title: USA: Rep Archer says Clinton tax cuts end in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Rep Archer says Clinton tax cuts end in 2000.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee chairman Bill Archer said Thursday President Clinton's tax proposal would automatically end five major tax cuts after Dec. 31, 2000, contrary to representations made by the administration in its fiscal 1998 budget.

Archer released a new study by the Joint Committee on Taxation, which estimated the Clinton tax plan would lead to a $13 billion tax increase in fiscal 2002. Archer told reporters legislative language provided by the Office of Management and Budget this week showed the tax cuts would not extend beyond 2000 without action by Congress.
